items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 49:1
items.html: For Ruach is drawn from the Hotem [nose], which is the discernment of ZA of the Rosh [head], that is, phase three; and it is known that it includes the six Sefirot HGT NHY, all of which are six parts of Ruach. (Chapter 6, Inner Light, Item 70)
